quests.instruction: Dark chocolate has less sugar than milk chocolate. Which taste stands out more in it?
quests.hint: Picture cocoa with no sugar added.
quests.explanation: Dark chocolate has more cocoa and less sugar, so a bitter taste comes through. Sweet is the taste of sugar, and sour is the sharp taste of fruits like lemons.
quests.funFact: Cocoa beans taste bitter on their own, and sugar is added to make most chocolate sweeter.

quests.instruction: What dessert is thick, smooth and creamy, and is eaten with a spoon?
quests.hint: It wobbles a little in its dish.
quests.explanation: Pudding is soft and creamy, so a spoon is the right tool. Cookies and pretzels are dry and crunchy.
quests.funFact: Puddings are often thickened with cornstarch or eggs.

quests.instruction: Which breakfast bread is flaky, with many thin buttery layers?
quests.hint: It shatters into flakes when you bite it.
quests.explanation: The folded layers of dough and butter puff apart in the oven, so a croissant turns out flaky. A bagel is dense and a pancake is soft.
quests.funFact: Croissant dough is rolled and folded with butter many times, which makes the thin layers.

quests.instruction: Carrots, lettuce and broccoli all belong to which food group?
quests.hint: Think of roots, leaves and flower buds from plants.
quests.explanation: These foods are all vegetables. Dairy comes from milk and protein foods include meat, eggs and beans.
quests.funFact: Vegetables can be roots like carrots, leaves like lettuce or flower buds like broccoli.

quests.instruction: Which snack is usually crunchy and salty?
quests.hint: It is light and made of puffed-up kernels.
quests.explanation: Plain popcorn is crispy and usually has salt on it. Yogurt is creamy and cookies are usually sweet.
quests.funFact: Archaeologists have found popcorn thousands of years old in the Americas.

quests.instruction: What dessert has a pastry crust on the outside and a fruit filling inside?
quests.hint: You cut it into wedges to share.
quests.explanation: A pie is baked in a crust that holds the filling. Cupcakes and donuts have no crust around a filling.
quests.funFact: Pies can also be savory, filled with meat or vegetables instead of fruit.

quests.instruction: Which leafy green herb adds a fresh flavor to tomato sauce and pizza?
quests.hint: A few small leaves are enough for a lot of smell.
quests.explanation: Herbs are leaves used in small amounts to add flavor. Basil is an herb, while lettuce and broccoli are vegetables we eat in larger amounts.
quests.funFact: Cooks often add basil at the end of cooking to keep its fresh flavor.

quests.instruction: Which large round fruit has a thick rind and sweet pale-green flesh around a center full of seeds?
quests.hint: Its flesh is cool and very juicy.
quests.explanation: A melon is big and round with soft flesh inside its rind. A pineapple is spiky and a kiwi is small and fuzzy.
quests.funFact: Melons, cucumbers and pumpkins are cousins in the same plant family.

quests.instruction: Which seafood has a curved body and turns pink when it is cooked?
quests.hint: It lives in the sea and has many little legs.
quests.explanation: Shrimp have shells that change from gray to pink as they cook. Fish have scales and chickens are land birds.
quests.funFact: Shrimp are small relatives of crabs and lobsters.

quests.instruction: Which bread is long and thin, with a crisp golden crust?
quests.hint: It is a classic bread from France.
quests.explanation: A baguette is shaped like a long stick and has a crunchy crust. A bagel is a chewy ring and a cupcake is a small cake.
quests.funFact: Bakeries in France bake fresh baguettes every day.

quests.instruction: Meat, fish, eggs and beans belong to which food group?
quests.hint: Many of these foods help muscles grow.
quests.explanation: These foods make up the protein group. Fruits and vegetables come from plants and are in groups of their own.
quests.funFact: Beans, lentils and nuts are plant foods that give us protein, too.

quests.instruction: Which small fruit is often eaten salty and comes in green or black?
quests.hint: It is soaked in salty water before it is eaten.
quests.explanation: Olives taste bitter when picked, so they are soaked in salty water, which makes them savory. Grapes and cherries are sweet.
quests.funFact: Olives grow on trees, and some are pressed to make olive oil.

quests.instruction: Mangoes, pears and grapes all belong to which food group?
quests.hint: Consider sweet foods that carry seeds.
quests.explanation: Mangoes, pears and grapes are fruits. Vegetables are other plant parts, and dairy comes from milk.
quests.funFact: Fruits can be eaten fresh, frozen, dried or as juice.

quests.instruction: Which warm meal is a spiced sauce with vegetables or meat, often served over rice?
quests.hint: Its spices give it a rich smell and color.
quests.explanation: Curry is a saucy dish flavored with spices. Sandwiches and pizza are not served as a sauce over rice.
quests.funFact: Many countries cook their own curries, including India, Thailand and Japan.

quests.instruction: What snack is rice pressed into a triangle and often wrapped with a strip of seaweed?
quests.hint: It is easy to carry and eat with your hands.
quests.explanation: A rice ball is cooked rice pressed together so it holds its shape. A dumpling is dough around a filling and a taco is a folded tortilla.
quests.funFact: In Japan, rice balls are called onigiri and are popular in lunchboxes.

quests.instruction: Which nut has a hard brown shell and is often roasted in the cooler months?
quests.hint: It grows on a tall tree.
quests.explanation: A chestnut is a tree nut with a hard shell around the part we eat. Corn grows on a cob and kiwis are fruits.
quests.funFact: Chestnuts grow inside spiky green cases that open when the nuts are ready.

quests.instruction: Which bread is thin and flat, like naan or pita, so it is easy to scoop up food?
quests.hint: It can be folded or torn into pieces.
quests.explanation: Flatbreads are baked thin, so they bend and wrap around food. A bagel is thick and a croissant is puffy.
quests.funFact: Flatbreads are some of the oldest kinds of bread, eaten in many cultures.

quests.instruction: Which fried ball is made from ground chickpeas and herbs?
quests.hint: It is popular in Middle Eastern food.
quests.explanation: Falafel is made by mashing chickpeas with herbs and frying small balls. A hot dog is a sausage and a pancake is made from batter.
quests.funFact: Chickpeas are legumes, like beans and lentils.

quests.instruction: Two of these foods are crunchy. Which one is not?
quests.hint: A spoon works better than your teeth for this one.
quests.explanation: A carrot and a pretzel crunch when you bite them, but yogurt is smooth and creamy.
quests.funFact: Greek yogurt is extra thick because some of the liquid is strained out.

quests.instruction: What food is made by wrapping a tortilla around fillings, instead of being picked straight from a plant?
quests.hint: It has to be put together before you can eat it.
quests.explanation: A burrito is assembled from a tortilla and fillings such as beans, rice or meat. Strawberries and carrots can be eaten as they are picked.
quests.funFact: The word burrito means little donkey in Spanish.

quests.instruction: Beans are cooked, sealed in a metal tin and stored on a pantry shelf. What kind of food is this?
quests.hint: Consider the tin they are sealed in.
quests.explanation: Food sealed in a can is called canned food. Dried food has lost its water, and fresh food is not preserved.
quests.funFact: Canned foods are heated in sealed cans, so they can be kept on a shelf for a long time before they are opened.

quests.instruction: Which cold treat is made of finely crushed ice topped with sweet syrup?
quests.hint: It melts into a sweet puddle on a hot day.
quests.explanation: Shaved ice is frozen water flaked into tiny pieces and flavored with syrup. Pudding is creamy and pie is baked.
quests.funFact: Shaved ice desserts called kakigori have been enjoyed in Japan for hundreds of years.

quests.instruction: Which of these fruits is the smallest?
quests.hint: You could eat a handful in one bite.
quests.explanation: Blueberries are tiny compared with a pineapple or a melon.
quests.funFact: Blueberries have a waxy coating that gives their skin a dusty look.

quests.instruction: Which crunchy snack is made from pressed rice and is common in Japan?
quests.hint: It is flat and light, and it shatters when you bite it.
quests.explanation: Rice crackers are rice that has been shaped, dried and baked until crisp. Popcorn is corn and pretzels are made from wheat dough.
quests.funFact: In Japan, rice crackers are called senbei and are often brushed with soy sauce.

quests.instruction: Which food is creamy and also frozen?
quests.hint: It must stay in the freezer.
quests.explanation: Ice cream is creamy and frozen. Pudding and yogurt are creamy too, but they are kept cool, not frozen.
quests.funFact: Vanilla, a favorite ice cream flavor, comes from the seed pods of an orchid.

quests.instruction: What snack is a legume that grows in pods under the ground?
quests.hint: Its plant pushes its pods into the soil.
quests.explanation: Peanuts are legumes, like beans, that form in pods underground. Some people are allergic to peanuts, so always ask a grown-up before sharing snacks.
quests.funFact: A peanut plant flowers above ground, then its stems bend down so the pods can grow in the soil.

quests.instruction: Which of these drinks is usually served hot?
quests.hint: It is made by soaking leaves in hot water.
quests.explanation: Tea is made by steeping leaves in hot water, so it is served warm. Smoothies and juice are cold drinks. A grown-up should handle hot drinks.
quests.funFact: Tea comes from the leaves of an evergreen plant called Camellia sinensis.

quests.instruction: Which leafy vegetable grows as a tight, round head of layered leaves?
quests.hint: Peel off a leaf and there is another one underneath.
quests.explanation: A cabbage is made of leaves that wrap around each other. Broccoli has a bumpy flower top and a carrot is a root.
quests.funFact: Sauerkraut and kimchi are made by letting cabbage ferment.

quests.instruction: Which meal is a thick mix of vegetables or meat in sauce, cooked slowly in a pot?
quests.hint: It simmers for a long time until everything is tender.
quests.explanation: A stew is cooked slowly so the pieces turn tender and the sauce gets thick. A salad is not cooked and a sandwich is not simmered.
quests.funFact: Many regions have their own stew, from Irish stew to Moroccan tagine.

quests.instruction: What treat is solid in its wrapper but turns soft and runny in a warm hand?
quests.hint: Leaving it in the sun is a messy idea.
quests.explanation: Chocolate melts at a low temperature, so heat turns it from a solid to a liquid. Cookies and pie stay solid when they warm up.
quests.funFact: Chocolate melts at about the temperature of the human body, which is why it can melt in your hand.
